title: Some and any
intro: Some, any, a and an with food words. Today’s grammar and words, and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Ovqat so’zlari bilan some, any, a va an. Bugungi grammatika, so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Lesson 11 · Some and any. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: Some, any, a or an?
items: There are {some|any} grapes on the plate.
There isn’t {some|any} milk in the fridge.
There {is|are} some rice in the bag.
There {is|are} some eggs on the table.

parts.title: Write some, any, a or an
parts.uz: Bo’sh joyga some, any, a yoki an yozing
items: There are ___ potatoes in the bag.
Is there ___ cheese in the fridge?
We don’t have ___ flour for samsa.
My father is buying ___ big melon.
There aren’t ___ cucumbers at the shop.
I need ___ salt for the soup.
Are there ___ grapes at the bazaar?

parts.title: Negatives and questions
items: There is some sugar in the tea.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: some / There / apples / are / on the table
need / for plov / some / I / rice

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: The shop is {next to|between} the bank.

items.prompt: Write 6 sentences about your kitchen or your fridge. Use some, any and food words.
items.hint: Example: There are some eggs in my fridge. There isn’t any milk. Is there any bread? Yes, there is.
